display_name: LoRa W24 分量方向训练的正式 Full 配对测试
description: Test two matched checkpoint readouts with the same grouped inference on the complete 30,000 Full matrix.
authorization: User requires formal Full test performance. Source scores are diagnostic.

code.environment: N607 CPU FP32 W24 archive, at most one prediction shard worker with two intraop threads and two replay workers; local independent CPU scorer.
code.cwd: Immutable formal release controller then original W24 archive for prediction workers.

data.representation: Continuous 8192 complex samples at 1 MHz through DURA; untouched W24 front end receives the resulting packet.
data.physical_ids_ref: Original fixed 15 unseen receiver x 2000 same-route physical packets. Clean and all six registered Full practical scenes.
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.validation_ref: Registered LoRa source/target contract with independent source seed, namespace and packets.
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Test fixed source-only weights through received-IQ-only grouped readouts and archived matching Full references. Independent truth-last after all three closed shards.

checkpoint.initialization: No adjustment. Load both source-frozen 48000-step peer heads and common legal Practical parent.

sources.role: Same-seed and same-budget unmodified source-only peer direction control, grouped forward.
Source-only Practical parent for center component energies and native edges.
Registered archived blind references for direct, old DURA, old complex response and wide all-packet half.
Frozen E104 with original default head and preprocessing.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Fixed terminal source-only proof, loaded real checkpoints with source U no-target smoke, original blind-reference exact bindings.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Both learned direction heads fit exclusively on legal source IQ with identical source contract.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Evaluate both fixed checkpoints on the same Full matrix after terminal freeze. No source accuracy gate and no target feedback.

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only. Wait for a valid frozen terminal checkpoint, then one CPU prediction shard worker, two inference and two replay threads.
execution.stop_rule: Stop for source freeze/provenance, technical smoke, prediction, immutable artifact or scoring error.

expected_artifacts: independent scores/scores.json with RX and TX results

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: w24_peer_formal_collect with component matrix; independent local target truth after all 3 shard closures.

rows.method: Fixed grouped readout of the matched old peer head and newly trained component direction head
rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.budget_ref: 3 independent 10,000 packet prediction shards. Same E104 and seven scenes; no fit.
expected_artifacts: independent scores/scores.json with RX and TX results

notes: Formal acceptance requires >=162000/180000 six practical, >=25500/30000 low urban and >=28566/30000 clean.
Component norms and native edges remain identical to the frozen parent before W24 rescaling. Two Learnable readouts always run.
Use existing archived blind controls. Report CPU-vs-archive direct disagreements. Preserve other CPU Full tasks.
Full only. No weak or Residual expansion in this experiment.
